evidence.quote: My instinct was that convoy references plus burst traffic plus unexplained code phrases fit a pattern I'd want to flag—an emerging logistics buildup ahead of some posture change.
evidence.explanation: The analyst builds an explanatory model that links disparate signal, linguistic, and behavioral indicators into a coherent causal account of adversary intent, going beyond retrieving or evaluating individual facts to forming an integrated interpretive hypothesis.

evidence.quote: I had a buildup narrative, partial open-source support, and this unresolved contradiction with the maintenance terminology... So I went moderate—buildup assessment, explicitly flagged the maintenance-terminology contradiction

evidence.quote: Just the signal signature data—volume, timing, burst patterns—and the historical baseline for both sectors. No content yet.

evidence.quote: He took the moderate framing at face value and tasked the follow-up collection
